name: Activehotel Bergkönig
beschreibung: The four-star Activehotel Bergkönig welcomes guests in the center of Neustift im Stubaital. This family-run active hotel features 36 spacious rooms and suites tailored for mountain and wellness getaways. Facilities include a generous spa area with indoor and outdoor pools as well as three indoor saunas and an outdoor sauna. Guests can enjoy regional Tyrolean cuisine and vital culinary offerings. In both summer and winter, the hotel serves as an ideal base for hiking, biking, and skiing throughout the Stubai Valley.
